Some famous words I've learned to adopt over the years:

Learn to respect the pump, and invite the pump into your life.

I was dead wrong the last couple of months and way too focused on "September having to be the bottom".

That's only a month away either way.

There's absolutely no reason to not be incredibly bullish right here even if we do see one last leg down before we rip again.

With that being said, I will resume being the most bullish person on the timeline again, even if I do mark a local top here.

It's felt unnatural to do anything else - even if it is on a shorter timeframe.

One thing I have not wavered on is that this bull market will be generational. I believe all of the catalysts are in place to finally see a real supercycle, and we're still not even in the first real inning of it.

Be more bullish.
